summary: Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch and TensorFlow inference, uncommitted. Verified: retrieve() returns pytorch-inference-graviton:1.12.1-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04-sagemaker for ml.c6g.4xlarge and tensorflow-inference-graviton:2.9.1-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04-sagemaker for ml.t4g.2xlarge; x86 ml.c5.4xlarge on 1.12.1 is unchanged. Changes: src/sagemaker/image_uris.py (new _is_graviton_instance helper and graviton repo override in retrieve), src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch.json and tensorflow.json (new 1.12.1 and 2.9.1 inference entries with a graviton sub-config). Not verified: existing unit tests could not be collected because the shared venv lacks the 'mock' package; I did not install it. A background run was killed before reporting. No unit tests were added for the new behaviour.
